quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad.

activation.condition: Ego stops, stands or parks near the nearest railroad rail.

exceptions.description: Traffic-conflict necessity and law, officer or device direction require independent original source review; nearby traffic alone proves no exception.
exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device
